text: Hi, I'm George. In the next few minutes I'll show you how to install Fetch Gen San, and book your first ride.
On Android, open Chrome and go to genestjanramirez dot com slash fetch. Tap the three-dot menu, then Install app. Or download the A P K from the link in the description.
On iPhone, open Safari and go to the same address. Tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen, and tap Add.
Now let's use it. Just follow the green circles.
Step 1. Log in with your email. No password to remember.
Step 2. Type the 6-digit code we email you.
Step 3. Verify yourself: real name, mobile number and a valid ID. Everyone on Fetch is verified.
Take a photo of your ID, then a selfie holding it.
This is your home screen. Pick Ride, Pabili or Delivery.
Your pick-up is set from your GPS. Now type where you are going.
Choose your driver. You see the real vehicle, plate number, rating and price.
Metered: pay by actual kilometres and minutes. Fixed offer: agree a price in chat.
Tap Send request.
Your driver accepted. Watch them come to you on the map, live.
Chat for free inside the app, or tap the phone to call.
Share your trip with family, and SOS is always one tap away.
The trip has started. The meter counts the distance and minutes live.
You have arrived. Send the total to the driver's G Cash and type the reference number.
Add a tip if you like, rate your driver and leave a comment.
Done! You earned suki points.
Suki rewards: 1 point for every 10 pesos. Ride more to unlock up to 10% off every trip.
Activity keeps every ride, pabili and delivery.
Meet George, your voice assistant. Tap the mic and just say what you need.
George filled in the Pabili for you. Ride. Pick. Deliver. Sa Gen San!
That is all there is to it. Ride. Pick. Deliver. Sa Gen San!
